[RCLI.1.6] **`strip-tests` removes an artefact's test content.** It reads a
`.dsc` and writes to the path `-o` names the same artefact without:

- every atom of the `Test*` scenario and `Oracle*` oracle families ([RDSC.7.1]); and
- the rules the compiler synthesized to realize a `produces` assertion's `where`
  predicate ([RLOW.17.2]), with every network node that serves only them.

That is the whole of what a compiled test adds ([RTIM.14.12]), so an engine runs
the stripped artefact's own rules exactly as it runs the original's. An artefact
with no test content is written unchanged.
